title: Tech Note: Using Form Sizing Options

historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser survives for this note, which covers new V6-era options for opening and sizing windows on screen. Window sizing/resizing concepts remain a normal part of form design, but the specific V6 window-type mechanics described are dated relative to the modern Form editor's resizing and anchoring properties.
related_updates: Form/window sizing and resizing controls have been substantially reworked in later 4D versions with more granular anchoring and responsive layout options
Design Mode-era form and window management has evolved considerably since V6 (1997), including in Project Mode introduced in v17 (2018)
